description_en: Verifies an SMS verification code and returns the verification result
description_zh: 核验短信验证码并返回核验是否成功的结果
name: CheckSmsVerifyCode

parameters.help_en:
The scheme name. The name can contain up to 20 characters. If you do not specify this parameter, the API uses the default scheme.
<notice>This value must match the `SchemeName` specified in the `SendSmsVerifyCode` request.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
方案名称，如果不填则为“默认方案”。最多不超过20个字符。
<notice>如果发送接口的方案名称不为空，请确保该参数不为空且与发送接口的方案名称参数一致></notice>
parameters.name: scheme_name

parameters.help_en: The country code of the phone number. The default value is `86`
parameters.name: country_code

parameters.help_en: An external ID to track the request
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en:
The verification code.

The `TemplateParam` parameter in the `SendSmsVerifyCode` request can be configured in two ways:

- `{"code":"##code##","min":"5"}`

- `{"code":"123456","min":"5"}`

If you use `{"code":"##code##","min":"5"}`, the API dynamically generates the verification code, and Alibaba Cloud can verify it.

If you use `{"code":"123456","min":"5"}`, you specify the verification code instead of the API generating one. Alibaba Cloud cannot verify this code.

Ensure you pass the correct verification code for your configuration
parameters.help_zh:
验证码。

SendSmsVerifyCode接口的字段TemplateParam，配置方式有2种：
- {"code":"##code##","min":"5"}
- {"code":"123456","min":"5"}
{"code":"##code##","min":"5"}验证码是api动态生成的，阿里云接口可以完成校验。
{"code":"123456","min":"5"}验证码是用户配置的不是api动态生成，阿里云接口无法校验。
请您按照实际情况传入对应的验证码
parameters.name: verify_code

parameters.help_en:
The case-sensitivity policy for verification. Valid values:

`1`: Case-insensitive.

`2`: Case-sensitive
parameters.help_zh:
验证码大小写字母核验策略。取值：

1：不区分大小写。
2：区分大小写
parameters.name: case_auth_policy

Code.description_en:
The status code of the request.

A value of `OK` indicates the request was successful.

For other error codes, see Error codes (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnvs/developer-reference/api-return-code?spm=a2c4g.11174283.0.0.70c5616bkj38Wa).
<notice>A successful request does not mean the SMS verification code is valid. The verification result is provided in the `Model.VerifyResult` parameter.></notice>
Code.description_zh:
接口请求状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。

其他错误码，请参见返回码 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnvs/developer-reference/api-return-code?spm=a2c4g.11174283.0.0.70c5616bkj38Wa)。
<notice>接口请求成功不代表短信验证码核验成功，短信验证码核验结果仅以`Model.VerifyResult`参数返回值为准。></notice>

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

Model.description_en: The data returned for the request

VerifyResult.description_en:
Indicates whether the SMS verification code is valid. Valid values:

`PASS`: The verification is successful.

`UNKNOWN`: The verification failed
VerifyResult.description_zh:
短信验证码核验结果。取值：

PASS：短信验证码核验成功。

UNKNOWN：短信验证码核验失败

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

`true`: The request was successful.

`false`: The request failed.
<notice>A successful request does not mean the SMS verification code is valid. The verification result is provided in the `Model.VerifyResult` parameter.></notice>
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：

true：接口调用成功。

false：接口调用失败。
<notice>接口调用成功不代表短信验证码核验成功，短信验证码核验结果仅以`Model.VerifyResult`参数返回值为准。></notice>
